q: By the oath of those winds that are released to give benefit
(to men such as those that fertilize plants and those that provide rain).
v.s: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
v.c: By those ˹winds˺ sent forth successively,

q: By the oath of those winds that blow extremely severely
v.s: And the winds that blow violently
v.c: and those blowing violently,

q: By the oath of those winds that spread out the clouds
(causing them to move together and to provide rain to places that most need) it).
v.s: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
v.c: and those scattering ˹rainclouds˺ widely!

q: By the oath of those winds that separate the clouds
(causing them to scatter and not to give any rain).
v.s: And those [angels] who bring criterion
v.c: And ˹by˺ those ˹angels˺ fully distinguishing ˹truth from falsehood˺,

q: By the oath of those winds that induce remembrance
v.s: And those [angels] who deliver a message.
v.c: and those delivering revelation,

q: (While beneficial winds are a sign of Allaah's mercy and prompt man to be grateful to Allaah, destructive winds instil fear in man's heart and prompt him to repent to Allaah so that he may be saved from punishment.)
v.s: As justification or warning,
v.c: ending excuses and giving warnings.

q: Verily what you have been warned about
v.s: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
v.c: Surely, what you are promised will come to pass.

q: (you will know that Qiyaamah has arrived)
when the light of the stars will be obliterated
v.s: So when the stars are obliterated
v.c: So when the stars are put out,

q: ...when the sky will be split (open up)...
v.s: And when the heaven is opened
v.c: and the sky is torn apart,

q: (tossed into the air by the violent convulsions of the earth)...
v.s: And when the mountains are blown away
v.c: and the mountains are blown away,

m: are gathered to their appointed time
v.s: And when the messengers' time has come...
v.c: and the messengers’ time ˹to testify˺ comes up—

q: For which day shall their matter
v.s: For what Day was it postponed?
v.c: for which Day has all this been set?

v.s: For the Day of Judgement.
v.c: For the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision!

q: What will tell you what is the Day of Judgement
v.s: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
v.c: And what will make you realize what the Day of Decision is?

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: Have We not destroyed the former nations...
v.s: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
v.c: Did We not destroy earlier disbelievers?

q: ...and then joined the later generations with them
v.s: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
v.c: And We will make the later disbelievers follow them.

q: Thus do We treat the criminals
(the Kuffaar). (Therefore, all Kuffaar should fear being punished in the world.)
v.s: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
v.c: This is how We deal with the wicked.

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

v.s: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
v.c: Did We not create you from a humble fluid,

v.s: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
v.c: placing it in a secure place

v.s: For a known extent.
v.c: until an appointed time?

q: We are certainly the best of those who make arrangements.
v.s: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
v.c: We ˹perfectly˺ ordained ˹its development˺. How excellent are We in doing so!

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: Have We not made the earth consist of...
v.s: Have We not made the earth a container
v.c: Have We not made the earth a lodging

q: (Just as the surface of the earth provides space for of the living, the interior of the earth provides a place of rest for the dead as well.)
v.s: Of the living and the dead?
v.c: for the living and the dead,

m: and We gave you to drink
q: (on the earth to give it stability)
(Despite all these blessings, why do you continue to be ungrateful by disobeying Our commands?)
v.s: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
v.c: and placed upon it towering, firm mountains, and given you fresh water to drink?

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: (The Kuffaar will be told on the Day of Qiyaamah,)
v.s: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
v.c: ˹The disbelievers will be told,˺ “Proceed into that ˹Fire˺ which you used to deny!
v.h: Bad News for the Deniers of Hell

q: (smoke, which is so dense that it will rise and divide into)
v.s: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.
v.c: Proceed into the shade ˹of smoke˺ which rises in three columns,

q: shade nor offer any protection from the flames.”
v.s: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
v.c: providing neither coolness nor shelter from the flames.

q: throws sparks as huge as palaces...
v.s: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
v.c: Indeed, it hurls sparks ˹as big˺ as huge castles,

q: ...(after which these enormous sparks break up into smaller sparks)
(When the sparks of Jahannam will be so huge, one cannot imagine the size of the whole of Jahannam itself.)
v.s: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
v.c: and ˹as dark˺ as black camels.”

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: This is that day when they
(because their mouths will be sealed and their limbs will start giving evidence against them)...
v.s: This is a Day they will not speak,
v.c: On that Day they will not ˹be in a position to˺ speak,

q: they will not be permitted to offer any excuses
v.s: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
v.c: nor will they be permitted to offer excuses.

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: (It will be announced on that day,)
“This is that Day of Judgement. We have gathered you together with the former nations.”
v.s: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
v.c: ˹They will be told by Allah,˺ “This is the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision: We have gathered you along with earlier disbelievers ˹for punishment˺.

q: (nothing you do will help you at all.)
v.s: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
v.c: So if you have a scheme ˹to save yourselves˺, then use it against Me.”

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: Verily those with Taqwa shall be
(of Allaah's throne on the Day of Qiyaamah and thereafter the shade of Jannah),
v.s: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
v.c: Indeed, the righteous will be amid ˹cool˺ shade and springs

v.s: And fruits from whatever they desire,
v.c: and any fruit they desire.

q: “Eat and drink all blessings as reward for the deeds you carried out
v.s: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “Eat and drink happily for what you used to do.”

q: Thus do We reward those who do good.
v.s: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
v.c: Surely this is how We reward the good-doers.

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: ˹But˺ woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: (Addressing the Kuffaar of this world, Allaah says,)
“Eat and enjoy yourselves for a few days. You are certainly sinners
v.s: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
v.c: “Eat and enjoy yourselves for a little while, ˹for˺ you are truly wicked.”

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: (to submit to Allaah's orders and to make Ruku in salaah),
v.s: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
v.c: When it is said to them, “Bow down ˹before Allah,” they do not bow.

q: May misery be the end of the rejecters on that day!”
v.s: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
v.c: Woe on that Day to the deniers!

q: So what will they believe in after
(When the Kuffaar refuse to believe in the miracle of the Qur'aan, which is so clear, one cannot expect them to believe in anything else.)
v.s: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
v.c: So what message after this ˹Quran˺ would they believe in?
